# GitHub workflows

| File | Responsibility |
| --- | --- |
| `test.yml` | Push/PR provider-free checks, full types/build and isolated migration replay/repeat. |
| `deploy-admin.yml` | Main-only manual release; Linux build, verified complete artifact and original ECS receiver. Deployment budget defaults to 20 minutes; operators may select 40, 60 or 90 for measured transfer requirements. Other submitted values use 20. Build and runtime resource budgets retain their current owners. |
